name: edens-prompt-hub
description: A personal prompt library with temporary copies, template variables, code snippet insertion, Antigravity & Codex integration, and Markdown verification checklists.

edenHub.storagePath.description: Custom directory for storing prompts and checklists. Leave empty to use the shared folder (~/.edens-prompt-hub) so prompts stay synced across VS Code and Antigravity IDE.
